question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined part in the following sentence.

Everyone called the reporter __a daredevil__ after he came back safely from the war zone.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"daredevil"** refers to a person who is adventurous and willing to take great risks. (साहसी व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** The daredevil skydiver performed stunts that amazed the audience.
 
 
 
• **"Fearless person"** refers to someone who is not afraid to take risks or face danger. (निर्भीक व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The fearless person marched forward without hesitation, even in the face of danger.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "A common man"** (साधारण व्यक्ति) refers to an average person who does not stand out in any particular way.

 
 
• **Example:** The common man struggles to make ends meet every day.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "An insignificant person"** (अहमियतहीन व्यक्ति) refers to someone who is not important or does not have an impact on others.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt like an insignificant person in a crowd of successful professionals.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "A hypocrite"** (पाखंडी) refers to someone who pretends to have moral standards or beliefs that they do not actually possess.
 
 
• **Example:** She was a hypocrite, always criticizing others while doing the same things herself.
